    type = internationalorganization
    show_message = no
    potential = { scope:actor = { tag = BYZ } }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_itp_need_on_tt has_variable = oe_itp_on }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_itp_need_city_tt owns = location:constantinople }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_itp_need_debt_tt foreign_debt < oe_itp_m18 }
        }
    }
    automation_tick = never
    ai_tick = never
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = international_organization
        source = actor
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_international_organization"
        none_available_msg_key = "leave_international_organization_none"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = { this = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        only_color_selectable = yes
        map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
        looking_for_a = country
        target_flag = target_country
        name = "oe_itp_borrow_select"
        none_available_msg_key = "oe_itp_borrow_none"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = { oe_itp_slot_country = yes }
        enabled = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_itp_need_t1_tt oe_itp_tgt_t1 = yes }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_itp_need_peace_tt NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_itp_need_op0_tt opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 0 } }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_itp_need_noloan_tt oe_itp_tgt_noloan = yes }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_itp_need_bcd_tt NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_bcd } }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_itp_need_pact_tt oe_itp_tgt_pact = yes }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:recipient = { this = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
                scope:actor = { has_variable = oe_itp_on owns = location:constantinople }
                exists = scope:target_country
                scope:target_country = { oe_itp_borrow_ok = yes }
            }
            custom_tooltip = oe_itp_borrow_tt
            hidden_effect = {
                scope:target_country = {
                    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_jb_loan value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_itp_bcd months = 24 }

                scope:actor = { trigger_event_silently = oe_itp.99 }
